systems.system: Bank of Uganda National Payment Switch (BNPS)

UGA.note: BNPS is being implemented, not in service; no licensing or drafting stated.
Consumer protection appears only as a task for the consultancy, not as rules in force or a complaints body.
EAPS and REPSS links are expected future integration, not in service.
G2P is only a priority use case to be assessed.
No survey share of adults stated.

facts.fact: The Terms of Reference describe Uganda's payment landscape as fragmented, with telecom-led mobile money services operating largely on isolated systems alongside banks and fintechs.

UGA.note: Document states nothing on revenue collection.
